surface_name: Claude Code on Amazon Bedrock Mantle
title: The sonnet alias on Bedrock Mantle now points at Sonnet 5 and fails if your account lacks that model
symptoms: sonnet alias returns a model access error on Bedrock Mantle after upgrading to 2.1.332
Sessions that used to run on Haiku 4.5 via the sonnet alias now error out
cause: Before 2.1.332 the sonnet alias on Bedrock Mantle resolved to Haiku 4.5 by mistake. It now resolves to Sonnet 5 (not 5.5), and an account without Sonnet 5 enabled gets an error instead of a fallback.
fix: Enable Sonnet 5 for the account in Bedrock before upgrading, or pin the model explicitly with ANTHROPIC_DEFAULT_SONNET_MODEL to one you have access to.
affected: Claude Code 2.1.332 and later on Amazon Bedrock Mantle
